claim: ADR 0302 method 3 and 5. The POS hub ingest writes pos_checks.channel only when the check names a channel the hub knows: checkChannelOf admits exactly 'table' and 'booth_event', and the ingest row's only channel key is a spread (never channel: check.channel ?? null). So a check that names none is stored even before the column exists, and a re-send that names none, or an unknown channel, leaves a stored channel alone. Every ingest result, the empty one included, carries a channels tally (booth_event, table, none, unrecognised) counted over every check received, refused and failed ones too. On the canonical feeds (generic_webhook, csv_import), and only there, a name the adapter dropped is read back from raw.channel; such a check is counted as unrecognised and not written as a channel, and errors[] says so without saying it was stored. A row with no stored channel reads as table service. A Square, Clover or Toast raw object is not read for a channel. The behaviour is pinned by apps/api-gateway/src/pos-hub/pos-hub.channel.spec.ts (a re-send naming an unknown channel leaves booth_event in place; a refused or failed check is not said to be stored; a provider's own channel key is not read).
